source: All 330 ShanghaiTech NORMAL training videos only

fit.colour: RGB (declared choice; upstream FPN loader uses BGR)

c01.N_attention: Final linear 1x30x30 score, raw channel sum

c02.N_attention: Final score channel sum, ReLU then per-image spatial max normalization

c03.N_attention: Last hidden post-BN/LeakyReLU512x31x31 feature, channel sum/ReLU/spatial max normalization

c04.N_attention: Same as c03; memory uses official MemAE raw dot code path

D_N.initialization: PyTorch module defaults, following zxVAD supplement default policy

O.input: Independent source donor RGB frame in [-1,1], no ImageNet normalization
O.mask: channel sum of final ReLU features / spatial max(clamp1e-8), threshold>0.1; nearest resize; no largest component
O.base: First frame of each input clip
O.paste: Continuous uniform center, betaUniform0..1, extent W/H*sqrt1-beta, clipped corners then integer truncation and min1 safeguard; resize full masked donor bilinear, mask nearest, replace only mask pixels

augment.input: Convert predicted RGB[-1,1] to clipped[0,1]; apply operations; clip then convert back
augment.draw_seed: 17+zero_based_step+700001 inside fork_rng; identical parameters across candidates

loss.SSIM: RGB independently; convert[0,1],L1;11Gaussian sigma1.5;K.01/.03;valid window;mean channels/pixels/batch
loss.gradient: FPN equivalent asymmetric SAME padding on right/bottom; absolute dx/dy then difference;full-map mean
loss.ArcFace: PML1.6.3 ArcFace m28.6degrees/scale64;normal+augmented normal labels1,pseudo label0;trainable class centres with N optimizer;library defaults

updates.order: G then D then N, single G prediction before G step reused detached for D/N
updates.guide_network_parameter_gradients: D/N frozen during G backward; BN remains train

sampler.generator: Round robin source video then random valid consecutive5 start (inclusive last valid start)
sampler.implementation: Precomputed NumPy shuffle buffer; not TensorFlow byte-identical
sampler.donor: Independent uniform source video and uniform frame

checkpoint.resume: Models including O/Arc,Adam states,RNG,plan and config identity;archive log beyond saved step
checkpoint.selection: Fixed final step only; no target selection

evaluation.begin: After all four fits complete; all presets retained
evaluation.first4: Excluded from both scores and labels
evaluation.normalization: Per-video minmax of available scored frames;constant videos all0
evaluation.metric: Pooled frame AUROC (abnormal label1);equal-target macro is summary
evaluation.bootstrap: Not reported; raw per-video scores support later reference computation

interpretation: Reproduction implementation exploration; these assumptions are disclosed, not author confirmed. Target-observed candidate choice would be development selection, not a new untouched final-test certification. No previous optimization method stacked.
